support_claim: The packet shows CRM MER-55 labeled Meridian Energy Partners, billing billed_name Meridian Energy Partners LLC, and notes referencing Meridian Energy Partners invoices, but no observation links MER-55 to that billing legal name as the same counterparty.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity evidence, and name similarity or compatible references are insufficient; DISTINCT requires evidence of distinctness, which the packet does not provide. Neither burden is met, so UNRESOLVED is the licensed disposition.
